sources.population: No data available from IMF or World Bank
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Fidel hands power to Raúl
geopolitical_news.summary: July illness forces Fidel Castro to cede control to his brother after 47 years in power.

geopolitical_news.headline: Succession grips the island
geopolitical_news.summary: Cubans await change as Raúl consolidates authority through the fall, with cautious reforms rumored in Havana.

sport.headline: Cuba reaches WBC final
sport.summary: Cuba loses to Japan in March in the inaugural World Baseball Classic final in San Diego.

geopolitical_news.headline: Raúl consolidates control
geopolitical_news.summary: The acting president reshuffles officials and hints at economic tweaks as Fidel fades from view.

geopolitical_news.headline: US keeps embargo stance
geopolitical_news.summary: Bush ties any thaw to democratic reforms Havana rejects as the succession unfolds without concessions.

sport.headline: Pan Am silver in Rio
sport.summary: Cuba finishes second in the medal table behind the United States at the Rio Pan Am Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Raúl formally becomes president
geopolitical_news.summary: February vote makes the succession official after five decades at the helm; Fidel resigns his posts.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hurricanes batter the island
geopolitical_news.summary: Gustav and Ike flatten crops and homes across western Cuba in the fall, causing billions in damage.

sport.headline: Robles' hurdles gold in Beijing
sport.summary: Dayron Robles wins the 110m hurdles in August; Cuba takes 24 medals, led by boxers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama eases Cuba restrictions
geopolitical_news.summary: April moves loosen remittances and family travel to the island in a first thaw after years of freeze.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economic crisis deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Falling export revenues force Havana to slash spending and imports as allies struggle through the year.

sport.headline: Early exit at the WBC
sport.summary: Cuba falls in the second round in March, missing the semifinals for the first time.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mass layoffs announced
geopolitical_news.summary: September plan to shed state jobs shocks Cuba's workforce as private enterprise expands under new licenses.

geopolitical_news.headline: Political prisoners freed
geopolitical_news.summary: Havana releases dissidents through the summer in a deal brokered with the Church and Spain.

sport.headline: Chapman defects to MLB
sport.summary: Aroldis Chapman signs with the Reds in January after defecting, in a record deal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Party congress backs reforms
geopolitical_news.summary: The April Communist Party congress approves market-oriented economic guidelines, known as the lineamientos, over six days.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cuentapropista boom begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Self-employment licenses surge as Cubans open restaurants and repair shops in a cautious opening.

sport.headline: Pan Am Games in Guadalajara
sport.summary: Cuba finishes second in the medal table behind the US in October with a strong boxing showing.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mariel port project advances
geopolitical_news.summary: The Brazil-financed Mariel mega-port project advances toward completion with a special economic zone attached.

geopolitical_news.headline: Reforms grind forward
geopolitical_news.summary: Agricultural cooperatives and private farming expand under Raúl's reform plan amid food shortages in the cities.

sport.headline: Boxers lead London medal haul
sport.summary: Cuba wins 14 medals with five golds at the London Olympics in July and August.

geopolitical_news.headline: Travel reform takes effect
geopolitical_news.summary: January end of exit permits lets Cubans travel more freely for the first time in decades.

geopolitical_news.headline: US-Cuba backchannel grows
geopolitical_news.summary: Secret Vatican-hosted talks advance toward a historic rapprochement through the year, kept from public view.

sport.headline: Puig's electric rookie season
sport.summary: Yasiel Puig's debut in June electrifies the Dodgers and Cuban fans after his daring defection.

geopolitical_news.headline: US and Cuba normalize ties
geopolitical_news.summary: December 17 announcement restores diplomatic relations after 54 years in a historic breakthrough brokered with Vatican help.

geopolitical_news.headline: Embargo debate reignites
geopolitical_news.summary: Washington moves to ease travel, remittance and trade limits as Congress resists repeal of the embargo.

sport.headline: Athletes allowed abroad
sport.summary: Cuba lets athletes sign professional contracts with foreign clubs in a landmark policy shift after decades of bans.

geopolitical_news.headline: Embassies reopen
geopolitical_news.summary: July ceremonies in Havana and Washington restore full diplomatic ties after 54 years of estrangement.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama loosens the embargo
geopolitical_news.summary: New rules expand travel, remittances and business with Cuba through executive action in January and September.

sport.headline: Baseball scouts return
sport.summary: Major League scouts return to the island as US-Cuba relations thaw, eyeing the next defectors-turned-stars.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama visits Havana
geopolitical_news.summary: March trip is the first by a US president in 88 years, drawing huge crowds.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fidel Castro dies
geopolitical_news.summary: November death at 90 in Havana ends an era; nine days of mourning follow.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economy falters
geopolitical_news.summary: Venezuelan aid shrinks and tourism wobbles, squeezing hard currency for ordinary Cubans through a difficult year.

sport.headline: Boxing golds at Rio
sport.summary: Cuban boxers and wrestlers deliver five of the country's gold medals at the Rio Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump rolls back opening
geopolitical_news.summary: November rules restrict travel and business with the military, reversing Obama's thaw in part amid Florida pressure.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sonic attacks mystery
geopolitical_news.summary: US diplomats report strange illnesses in a baffling episode blamed on unknown causes; Washington pulls staff from Havana.

sport.headline: WBC second-round exit
sport.summary: Cuba again falls short of the semifinals in March's tournament amid more defections.

geopolitical_news.headline: Díaz-Canel becomes president
geopolitical_news.summary: April's handover to Miguel Díaz-Canel in a National Assembly vote ends six decades of Castro rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: New constitution drafted
geopolitical_news.summary: The National Assembly approves a new charter recognizing private property for a 2019 referendum.

sport.headline: Cuba tops the CAC Games
sport.summary: Cuba wins the medal table at the Barranquilla regional games in July and August.

geopolitical_news.headline: New constitution takes effect
geopolitical_news.summary: A February referendum approves the new constitution with presidential term limits and private property rights.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump tightens the screws
geopolitical_news.summary: Fresh US sanctions target tourism, remittances and Venezuelan oil shipments, squeezing the economy through the year.

sport.headline: MLB-Cuba deal killed
sport.summary: Washington blocks in April a pact letting Cuban players join MLB legally, ending hopes of orderly migration.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 reaches Cuba
geopolitical_news.summary: March lockdowns close borders as Cuba sends doctors abroad to fight the virus across the region.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economic freefall
geopolitical_news.summary: Tourism collapses and food and medicine shortages worsen through the year as dollars dry up.

sport.headline: Sports grind to a halt
sport.summary: The pandemic suspends the baseball season and Olympic preparations nationwide in March, with Tokyo postponed.

geopolitical_news.headline: 11J protests erupt
geopolitical_news.summary: July demonstrations, the largest in decades, demand freedom and food before a swift crackdown with mass arrests.

geopolitical_news.headline: Currency unification
geopolitical_news.summary: January's currency unification ends the dual-peso system, fueling inflation and hardship for ordinary Cubans.

geopolitical_news.headline: Díaz-Canel takes party helm
geopolitical_news.summary: April congress makes him Communist Party chief as Raúl retires from public life, completing the transition.

sport.headline: López wins fourth straight gold
sport.summary: Mijaín López's wrestling gold in August highlights Cuba's Tokyo haul, a historic Olympic feat.

geopolitical_news.headline: Exodus accelerates
geopolitical_news.summary: Record numbers of Cubans migrate to the US through Nicaragua and the Darién amid crisis, in a historic wave.

geopolitical_news.headline: Family Code referendum
geopolitical_news.summary: A September referendum approves same-sex marriage and broader family rights in a government-backed vote.

sport.headline: Talent drain to MLB continues
sport.summary: Cuban-born stars thrive in the majors as the island's pipeline empties, with more defections.

geopolitical_news.headline: Díaz-Canel wins second term
geopolitical_news.summary: April vote extends his presidency for five more years in a rubber-stamp assembly amid blackouts and shortages.

geopolitical_news.headline: Migration crisis deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands flee as the economy collapses further, in the largest exodus in decades.

sport.headline: Cuba reaches WBC semifinals
sport.summary: With MLB defectors aboard, Cuba falls to the US in Miami in March.

geopolitical_news.headline: Blackouts spark protests
geopolitical_news.summary: October's island-wide grid collapse leaves millions without power for days, triggering street protests in Havana and beyond.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economy in freefall
geopolitical_news.summary: Inflation soars and basic goods vanish through the year as tourism fails to recover and allies cut aid.

sport.headline: López wins unprecedented fifth gold
sport.summary: Mijaín López retires in August after a fifth straight wrestling title in Paris, an Olympic first.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump 2.0 squeezes Cuba
geopolitical_news.summary: Renewed US pressure in Trump's second term targets Cuba's oil supplies and remittance flows with tougher sanctions.

geopolitical_news.headline: Energy crisis deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Daily blackouts stretch for hours as fuel runs short through a grim year with no relief in sight.

sport.headline: Baseball looks to 2026 Classic
sport.summary: Cuba courts MLB-based players for the next World Baseball Classic after 2023's semifinal run.
